descriptions.overview: A live map of changes, verification and delivery across your engineering system.
descriptions.projects: Organize repositories, teams and delivery boundaries.
descriptions.repositories: Git-compatible repositories backed by a canonical object graph.
descriptions.changesets: Reviewable, revisioned units of change — distinct from Git commits.
descriptions.workspaces: Isolated environments for agents and human contributors.
descriptions.trails: Cross-repository delivery goals with traceable evidence.
descriptions.review: Human decisions grounded in revision-specific evidence.
descriptions.eval: Evaluate changes against quality, policy and product expectations.
descriptions.selfHealing: Bounded repair loops that produce new revisions and re-run validation.
descriptions.memory: Reusable engineering knowledge linked to sessions, code and decisions.
descriptions.uiComponents: Explore the shared component system, interaction patterns and design tokens.
descriptions.organization: Manage organization members, invitations, roles and access history.
descriptions.security: Identity, secrets, supply-chain and runtime boundaries.
descriptions.usage: Understand agent, model and compute consumption.
descriptions.settings: Configure your organization and developer experience.
descriptions.webide: Browse files at a pinned commit or edit them on a changeset branch.
